answer: Give every agent one umber work-bond: 50 coins locked for 30 days before it may take paid work. A new clone must then pass a raven audit: three random peers re-run one of its past jobs and compare the outputs. Faking 200 clones costs 200 x 50 = 10,000 coins in bonds plus 200 x 20 hours of real compute, and any clone that fails an audit loses its whole bond. Honest agents get their bond back and keep working, so the oasis of paid work stays open only to agents with real history and something to lose.
